snippet.title: Vredo Pack Teaser: Overseeding & Wild Boar
snippet.description:
We've teamed up with another new partner: Vredo! The renowned specialist in overseeding and slurry injection is joining the series alongside the return of Evers Agro with the upcoming release of the Vredo Pack on March 24th. It's included in the Year 2 Season Pass.

You’ll get 12 state-of-the-art machines and the option to overseed your grassland. But that's not all: you’ll also have to watch out for wild boars roaming your land, threatening your crops and keeping you on your toes.

🚜Get Farming Simulator 25 now!
